# Keep the Light 1.24.1

- **Fixed:** the "Add several files…" line no longer flashes on an empty queue.
- **Start no longer adds the file as well.** When files are waiting, the main button is always **Start queue**, and **Add to queue** is the separate button next to it.
- **UI-12: tighter spacing.** About half the empty space around and between sections is gone, so more fits on screen. Text is the same size. Like UI-1 to UI-11, it can be undone on its own.
